mu_name_from: NPC/DevilNpc01.bmd, loaded as MODEL_NPC_DEVILSQUARE (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1911-1914), MuMain's MONSTER_CHARON at the default scale (ZzzCharacter.cpp:14392-14395). Type 237, OpenMU's 'Charon' with NpcWindow.DevilSquare. Not Version075's: OpenMU's 0.95d stands him in Noria at 171,105 facing SouthEast (Version095d/Maps/Noria.cs:32).
why_this_one: The user asked for Devil Square's NPC (2026-09-30). A robed figure in gilt plate, 456 triangles on one 256 sheet. Devil Square is not written, so he stands and says so.
sheet_from: Out of Data/NPC, beside the model, decoded under an npc_ prefix.
sheet_materials_from: One page carrying his face, his robe and his plate together, so skin, as every townsperson's shared page does.
effects_from: RenderCharacter's MODEL_NPC_DEVILSQUARE case (ZzzCharacter.cpp:11249-11268), the light held in his hands, drawn in code (Play::gatherFolkLights, Play::orbs; play_tuning.h's kCharonOrb*): two BITMAP_LIGHTNING+1 (lightning_2) sprites at bone 20 offset (3.5, -12, 10), Scale 0.3, turning opposite ways at WorldTime/50 degrees, lit sin(WorldTime*0.002)*0.35+0.65 grey; and a BITMAP_JOINT_ENERGY wisp every half second from a point 50 units round it, rising twenty frames and homing back in. Ours: the wisp's ribbon is eight round `light` dots in JointEnergy01's pale blue, its homing a straight line, and the SOUND_GET_ENERGY on each landing is left out.
